title: ETL vs ELT: Why ELT Wins in Modern Data

scenes.say: Ever wonder why ELT is everywhere now? What made it take over classic ETL?

scenes.label: ETL
scenes.sub: Transforms data before loading into the destination.
scenes.say: ETL means you transform data before loading it into your warehouse or database.

scenes.label: ELT
scenes.sub: Loads raw data first, then transforms inside the warehouse.
scenes.say: ELT flips the script. You load raw data first, then transform it right inside the warehouse.
Modern cloud warehouses like BigQuery or Snowflake are built for ELT. They handle huge transformations right where the data lives.

scenes.code:
select * from raw_data
where updated_at > last_watermark
scenes.say: Tools like dbt make ELT even easier. You can transform data with SQL and only process new records.

scenes.question: Why is ELT preferred in cloud platforms?
scenes.right: Because warehouses optimize transformations, making ELT faster and more scalable.
scenes.say: Don't fall for the simplicity trap. ELT wins because cloud warehouses are optimized for transformations after loading.
